description:
[Deterministic banking validation. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Performs ISO 13616 MOD-97 mathematical validation, SWIFT BIC identification, Peppol directory participant routing lookup, and geographic country coherence cross-check for Business Email Compromise (BEC) and wire fraud prevention.
Usage: Use this tool to verify bank account format legitimacy and detect geographic discrepancies between supplier declared country and bank routing country before releasing SEPA payments.
Returns: JSON object with { isValid: boolean, iban: string, country: string, bic: string, bankName: string, isDomesticMatch: boolean, fraudRiskScore: number, warnings: string[] }.

domain.description: Supplier website or email domain (e.g. supplier.it)

vatCountry.description: Expected supplier VAT country code (e.g. IT) for discrepancy detection

name: iban_sepa_antifraud
